items.name: Farm Sanctuary
items.description: National farmed-animal rescue and advocacy organization founded in 1986, with a Southern California shelter in Acton that runs public tours and volunteer days.

items.name: The Gentle Barn
items.description: Sanctuary in Santa Clarita for rescued cows, horses, pigs, goats and chickens, open to the public on Sundays with private visits by reservation.

items.name: Animal Place
items.description: Farmed-animal sanctuary in Grass Valley, California, founded in 1989, offering public guided tours and publishing its events as an ICS feed.
